episodeTitle.en: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)
episodeTitle.zh: AI 的第三个时代：能持续与你共事的 AI 同事正在兴起｜OpenAI 产品负责人 Tara Seshan

guestBioOfficial.zh: Tara Seshan 在 OpenAI 负责 ChatGPT Work 等产品，与工程负责人 Andrew Ambrosino 共事。此前她是 Stripe 最早的五位产品经理之一。她经常把工具放进自己的工作日，借此发现演示和长期使用之间的差距。
guestBioOfficial.en: Tara leads product work on ChatGPT Work at OpenAI alongside engineering leader Andrew Ambrosino. An early Stripe PM, she puts the tools into her own working day to see what holds up beyond a demo.

title.en: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)
title.zh: AI 的第三个时代：能持续与你共事的 AI 同事正在兴起｜OpenAI 产品负责人 Tara Seshan

summary.zh: 一次聊天结束后，如果 AI 还能记住项目、继续工作，并把成果交给同事，产品应该怎么设计？Tara 从自己整天使用产品谈起，举出用网站替代静态文档的例子，也解释为什么知识工作的验收比跑通一套代码测试更难。
summary.en: Tara explores what changes when an AI collaborator stays with a project. She describes using the tools all day, replacing some documents with websites, and the difficulty of evaluating knowledge work as cleanly as code.

insights.title: 用一整天检验工具是不是同事
insights.detail: 团队会彼此追问，有没有连续用自家产品处理日常任务。演示里顺利的一次交互，经不起反复使用时，问题很快就会暴露。
insights.detailEn: The team asks whether people have used the product continuously through a working day. Repeated use tests a different claim from a successful demo.
insights.titleEn: Use it through a full workday

insights.title: 交付物可以随生成成本一起改变
insights.detail: Tara 过去常交付文档或表格。做网站变得足够快之后，她会直接把想法变成可操作的网站，再决定和谁分享。
insights.detailEn: As websites became quick to create, Tara started using them for work she once delivered as documents and spreadsheets.

insights.title: 先问工作成果能怎么验收
insights.detail: 代码常有测试和可运行结果；许多知识工作缺少同样清楚的终点。为后者设计协作工具，首先得弄懂好结果如何判断。
insights.detailEn: Code often has tests or a runnable result. Designing an AI coworker for knowledge work starts with asking how people recognize a good outcome.
insights.titleEn: Define how to assess the outcome

related.reason: 从同一团队工程负责人的角度看 Codex 与 ChatGPT 为什么走到一起。
related.reasonEn: The engineering perspective on bringing Codex and ChatGPT together.

title.en: Why OpenAI is merging Codex and ChatGPT and the future of knowledge work | Andrew Ambrosino
title.zh: 为什么 OpenAI 正在合并 Codex 和 ChatGPT？未来知识工作的走向 | 安德鲁·安布罗西诺
